roadmap.notes: UI steps (Phase 2, 03-03) have no test_file references — UI acceptance is manual browser testing. Backend API they consume is tested via acceptance tests.

steps.name: Vendor Regorus WASM and load in Bun
steps.criteria: Regorus WASM loads successfully and remains cached. Unit test compiles a hardcoded Rego string and queries allow/deny. vendor/regorus-src/ submodule and vendor/regorus-wasm/ build output committed.
steps.scenario_name: compiles and evaluates hardcoded Rego policy

steps.name: Schema migration: replace condition with rego_source
steps.criteria: schema/migrations/0088_replace_condition_with_rego_source.surql created. Removes rules fields, adds rego_source string. bun migrate applies cleanly. INFO FOR TABLE policy shows rego_source field.

steps.name: RegoEvaluator: compile, evaluate, map result
steps.criteria: compileRego() returns success or errors with line/column. Policy evaluation returns decision (allow/deny with messages) and optional evidence requirement. Package validation rejects non-osabio.policy packages. Fail-closed on no match. Engine cache by policyId:version.
steps.scenario_name: evaluateRegoPolicy returns allow, deny with messages, evidence requirement, and fail-closed on no match

steps.name: Wire RegoEvaluator into policy gate, remove predicate evaluator
steps.criteria: evaluatePolicyGate() uses Rego evaluator for each policy. predicate-evaluator.ts deleted. PolicyRecord uses rego_source. Signature unchanged. Walking skeleton passes: create Rego policy, activate, evaluate intent, verify deny/allow and trace. WASM failure returns deny with error reason.
steps.scenario_name: active deny policy blocks a deploy intent and records policy trace

steps.name: Rego compilation validation on policy create/update
steps.criteria: Invalid Rego rejected with {line, column, message}. Wrong package rejected. Valid Rego accepted. Legacy rules field rejected. policy-validation.ts rewritten for Rego compilation. Unit and route-level validation tested.
steps.scenario_name: rejects invalid Rego syntax with line/column errors

steps.name: Update acceptance tests for Rego policy lifecycle
steps.criteria: All tests in policy-node/ pass with rego_source payloads. policy-test-kit.ts types updated. Milestone-1 and milestone-2 tests cover create, activate, deprecate, version, deny short-circuit, allow, fail-closed, evidence requirement, human veto.
steps.scenario_name: deny rule at priority 100 blocks intent before lower-priority allow rule is evaluated

steps.name: Add CodeMirror 5 with codemirror-rego dependency
steps.criteria: codemirror, codemirror-rego, and react-codemirror2 installed. A minimal RegoEditor component renders with Rego syntax highlighting, line numbers, and bracket matching.

steps.name: Replace RuleBuilder with RegoEditor in CreatePolicyDialog
steps.criteria: CreatePolicyDialog renders RegoEditor instead of RuleBuilder. Form submits rego_source to POST /policies. Field reference panel shows IntentEvaluationContext fields. RuleBuilder.tsx deleted.

steps.name: Add Validate button with inline error display
steps.criteria: Validate button calls POST /policies/validate. Success shows green checkmark. Failure shows errors with line numbers. CodeMirror gutter markers highlight error lines.

steps.name: Display rego_source on policy detail page
steps.criteria: PolicyDetailPage renders rego_source in read-only CodeMirror with Rego syntax highlighting. No edit capability in detail view.

steps.name: Version diff view for Rego source
steps.criteria: VersionDiffView shows diff of rego_source between two policy versions. Uses CodeMirror merge addon or text diff component.

steps.name: Backend: POST /policies/:id/test endpoint
steps.criteria: Accepts mock IntentEvaluationContext JSON, evaluates rego_source, returns { decision, messages, evidence_requirement?: { min_count, required_types? } }. 404 for missing policy. 400 for invalid input. Requires workspace authentication.
steps.scenario_name: test policy with mock input that triggers deny

steps.name: Backend: POST /policies/validate endpoint
steps.criteria: Accepts { rego_source }, compiles via Regorus, returns { success } or { success: false, errors: [{ line, column, message }] }. No policy record created. Requires workspace authentication.
steps.scenario_name: validate endpoint returns compilation errors for invalid Rego

steps.name: UI: PolicyTestPanel component
steps.criteria: PolicyTestPanel on policy detail page. JSON editor for mock input. Test button calls POST /policies/:id/test. Displays decision with messages. Handles error states (400, 404, network).
